_note: Order = App Store order. The first three show in search results. Captions must stay true to the shipping build. Capture file names: <id>.png in captures/iphone and captures/ipad.

shots.caption:
A little wash.
A delighted friend.
shots.capture: Little Wash hero: fire truck half clean with readable foam, tools visible below. Capture the shipping build after founder approval; no score, timer or adult UI.

shots.caption:
Nine calm toys.
No ads, no tracking.
shots.capture: The shelf by day, all nine toys visible (LULL_DEBUG_FULL=1). Wren awake and centred. No adult gate or welcome on screen.

shots.caption:
Feed each friend
the snack they want
shots.capture: Feed with grandmother asking (thought bubble showing the wanted food), food on its plates. Ideal: the happy or laughing frame right after a correct feed.

shots.caption:
Mix and match
felt friends
shots.capture: Mix-Up with a clearly mixed friend (for example rabbit head, bear body, frog legs) standing on the stand, controls visible.

shots.caption:
Wander a meadow
that wakes as you play
shots.capture: Meadow mid-walk: ladybug on a painted spring trail, one landmark awake (stump or pond face), butterflies. Daytime.

shots.caption:
Make gentle music
with a touch
shots.capture: Hum with two or three notes glowing or singing (hold two fingers while capturing, or capture a frame just after a chord).

shots.caption:
Post shapes and
open the drawer
shots.capture: Sleepy Box with two shapes posted and one mid-drag near its hole.

shots.caption:
Watch the day
drift into evening
shots.capture: Window at dusk with the dial part-way, lamp glowing, a guest object on the sill.

shots.caption:
Grown-ups set the pace.
One purchase, no subscription.
shots.capture: Grown-up area top: status card with the real App Store price, preview strip, play timer row. RELEASE build only (Debug shows a developer button).
